decisions.reason: The page 19 instruction changes photo selection within the dedicated photo-treatment Requirement; it does not change the document-wide layout or graphic-treatment rules.
Removing or replacing the page 19 photo does not change the Agua Arc identity or required brand assets.
The source concerns a photograph on page 19 and does not alter any table-integration requirement.
The page 19 photograph is distinct from the one-page cover letter and its favored-image relocation rule.
The photo-selection revision does not change Canva access, ownership, editability, or asset policy.
The page 19 photo instruction has no effect on hyperlink functionality.
The source changes proposal imagery, not narrative content, section order, or the unresolved inclusion of Section 6.
The photo-selection revision does not alter the required PDF format, file count, export quality, or email submission method.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ proposal and does not affect the TPEC proposal.
Although leaving one photo could incidentally affect page composition, the source does not change the page-limit goal or prescribed page-reduction approach.
This individual revision instruction does not change the number or trigger of the consolidated revision round.
The page 19 photo change does not modify any delivery date, turnaround period, or revision scheduling condition.
